explanation: Compared against OEIS A240088: a(n) = number of ways to write n as an ordered sum of a triangular number, a square and a pentagonal number; conjectured always positive (Sun 2009, Conjecture 1.1; verified below 10¹⁰). The Lean `a` counts (i,j,k) ∈ [0,n+1]³ with T_i + j² + P_5(k) = n; the range suffices, and since i ↦ T_i, j ↦ j², k ↦ k(3k−1)/2 are injective on ℕ, counting index triples equals counting representations. Test values a(0..4) = 1,3,3,2,3 match. The statement ∀ n, 0 < a n is the conjecture. Faithful.
